package.name: force_core
package.description:
Pure C++ force-staging sequencing logic (ForceStageFsm, ForceStageSequencer) for the APPROACH/CARTESIAN/RETRACT contact-force lifecycle -- no rclcpp, no ROS message dependencies, no clock, no I/O. Builds and tests with ROS not sourced.
Extracted from manipulation_manager once a genuine cross-tree consumer at the platform tier (compliant_trajectory_controller, a fused JTC+admittance controller prototype) needed this logic, and platform packages may not depend on capabilities orchestration packages (the repo's dependency-direction rule; docs/package_layout.md covers the core/adapter split). force_segment_expander stayed behind in manipulation_manager: unlike the FSM/sequencer, it depends on manager-specific types (MotionSegmentSpec, CoverageSource) and was never designed to be portable.
